channel.title: NorthEast News
channel.description: Clear, fast reporting for New Hampshire and New England.

item.title: New Hampshire voters head to polls as open Senate seat reshapes 2026 races
item.description: Tuesday’s primary is the first major test of the campaigns competing to succeed retiring U.S. Sen. Jeanne Shaheen.

item.title: Boston Scientific says cyberattack could hit its 2026 outlook
item.description: The Marlborough-based medical-device maker said an August incident disrupted parts of its global operations.

item.title: Qualcomm and Amazon deepen AI-chip ties in multibillion-dollar agreement
item.description: The deal expands Amazon’s custom-chip push and gives Qualcomm another foothold in AI infrastructure.

item.title: New Hampshire businesses build community around alcohol-free drinks
item.description: Concord and Manchester businesses are adding nonalcoholic drinks and social spaces as more customers look for alternatives to traditional bars.

item.title: Concord farm meets high local demand for greens after lettuce recalls
item.description: A two-person farm says it has been selling out weekly as shoppers and restaurants put a premium on local lettuce and microgreens.

item.title: UMass Boston chancellor plans to step down in February
item.description: Marcelo Suárez-Orozco will leave the post after seven years, closing a tenure that included campus growth and a major capital overhaul.

item.title: Eastern Massachusetts seeks more Quabbin water as review begins
item.description: A request for up to 20 million additional gallons a day is prompting questions about which communities need the supply and what alternatives were considered.

item.title: Rhode Island governor primary rematch centers on bridge and trust
item.description: Incumbent Dan McKee and Helena Foulkes are facing each other again, with the Washington Bridge crisis and state leadership at the center of the contest.

item.title: What Rhode Island voters should know before Wednesday’s primary
item.description: The state’s Sept. 9 primary will release results through 39 local jurisdictions, with early and mail ballots mixed into the night’s reporting.

item.title: New Hampshire school-ID voting rule gets first test at UNH
item.description: A new identification rule was challenged in federal court but appeared to create few problems for Durham voters during Tuesday’s primary.

item.title: Springfield public schools close after cyber incident
item.description: All public schools and after-school activities were canceled Tuesday while officials investigated an incident affecting systems used for essential operations.

item.title: South Station’s high-tech fare gates hit a weather problem
item.description: Nearly half the commuter-rail gates were covered during a recent rainy morning, limiting ticket scanning at Boston’s busiest station.

item.title: Massachusetts data centers face local approval before state permits
item.description: Gov. Maura Healey’s new order requires community agreements and bars state-agency nondisclosure deals with proposed facilities.

item.title: Biotech shares slide after Novartis muscle-disease trial setback
item.description: Dyne, Sarepta and PepGen fell after a late-stage Novartis drug failed to show a statistically significant benefit in a muscle-disease trial.

item.title: Software stocks fall as investors weigh the next AI disruption
item.description: Salesforce, Intuit and ServiceNow were among the software names under pressure as investors turned to inflation data and the pace of AI adoption.

item.title: Patriots’ Christian Gonzalez agrees to record cornerback contract
item.description: The four-year, $135 million deal would make Gonzalez the highest-paid cornerback in NFL history, according to people who spoke with the AP.

item.title: Neighbors and firefighters rescue 17-year-old dog in Dorchester
item.description: Milly, who is blind and deaf, wandered from her fenced yard before a neighborhood search brought her safely home about four hours later.
